actions.name: Exploration
actions.description: Explore new territories and discover resources, ancient ruins, or potential settlements.
outcomes: Find ancient ruins with magical artifacts
Uncover hostile territory requiring military action

actions.name: Build Structure
actions.description: Construct buildings that generate resources, provide defensive benefits, or enhance capabilities.

actions.name: Conscription
actions.description: Raise armies from your population to defend territory or expand influence.
outcomes: Train elite forces for special operations

actions.name: Move Army
actions.description: Deploy military forces across the world map for conquest, defense, or exploration.

actions.name: Spying
actions.description: Gather intelligence on other players, discover their plans, or sabotage their operations.

actions.name: Repair & Heal
actions.description: Restore damaged structures and heal wounded units after conflicts or natural disasters.
outcomes: Restore damaged buildings to full capacity

actions.name: Sabotage
actions.description: Disrupt enemy resources, destroy structures, or weaken military forces through covert operations.

actions.name: Social Development
actions.description: Improve society through education, culture, and governance to increase efficiency and happiness.

actions.name: Research Technology
actions.description: Advance magical and technological capabilities to unlock new actions and improve existing ones.

actions.name: Incite Uproar
actions.description: Cause or suppress revolts and social unrest in your own or enemy territories.

actions.name: Build Siege Weapons
actions.description: Construct catapults, ballistae, and other siege equipment to break enemy fortifications.

actions.name: Establish Trade Route
actions.description: Create economic connections with other players or neutral cities for mutual benefit.
